name: hud_ui_text_input_constructor
description: HudUiTextInput::Constructor initializes the text buffer and keyboard action map.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x4b42f0 yet; the helper currently has functional evidence only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x4b42f0 validates ftable setup, zero cursor/buffer/capacity, AllocTextBuffer(bufferSize), printable-character key map initialization, and special actions for space, '.', escape, enter, backspace, delete, Ctrl-B, and Ctrl-F.

The native text-input smoke verifies direct HudUiTextInput construction, buffer allocation, cursor initialization, printable/control key map entries, SetContents, GetBuffer, and DestructorCore cleanup.
